newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania parliament passes vital 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Romania parliament passes vital 1997 budget.

text.p: Romania's parliament on Thursday passed the 1997 state budget, crucial for reforms and securing fresh credits from international lenders.
Members approved the budget by 230 votes to 157 after a week of debate under emergency procedures. The leftist and nationalist opposition voted against.

Under the document presented by the new centrist coalition, the state budget deficit was set at 12.6 trillion lei or 5.4 percent of gross domestic product, which is expected to fall by three percent after a 4.1 percent growth in 1996.
